sources.title: AnubhavKarki/hf-food-not-food-classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: A complete NLP text classification project that fine tunes DistilBERT to classify whether a sentence is about food or not food. This project covers the full workflow from dataset loading and preprocessing to model training, evaluation, Hugging Face Hub deployment, and a Gradio demo for interactive inference.
